title: ChiMorse: Symmetry-constrained Fourier–Morse models for anisotropic pair interactions
description: ChiMorse is a Python package for constructing compact, symmetry-constrained Fourier–Morse representations of anisotropic pair interaction potentials. It provides tools for data loading, radial fitting, symmetry-adapted Fourier representations, coefficient pruning, model evaluation, error analysis, visualization, and model export.
